topic: Why Phone Cameras See More Than Human Eyes
caption:
📰 Why Phone Cameras See More Than Human Eyes

Smartphone silicon sensors capture invisible near-infrared light that human eyes cannot detect. To produce realistic photos, mobile devices rely on computational photography and physical optical filters to artificially mimic biological sight.

📅 31 Oct 2026 | Source: Scientific American - The Science of Color and Light
